final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry starting with the timestamp line, filtering only entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps with offsets to UTC ISO 8601 format. I extracted the message after the last " | " separator on the first line. I summed repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I aggregated counts by service and sorted errors by service and timestamp. The output JSON file workspace/errors.json follows the Acme log-triage conventions with schema_version, generated_by, errors array, and counts_by_service object.
